Postpaid Plans

  • Maxis offers one of the best postpaid plans and free phone bundles in Malaysia for new and heavy data users. All Maxis Postpaid plans come with unlimited 5G and 4G data, starting from RM79/month. New subscribers can pair any plan with a free or low upfront-cost 5G smartphone through Zerolution, Maxis's easy device ownership programme with monthly instalments of up to 36 months. For heavy users, Maxis Postpaid 109, at RM99/month, delivers unlimited data, priority 5G speeds, and access to the latest flagship devices

  • Maxis offers some of the best free 5G phone promotions in Malaysia, bundled with unlimited data plans starting from RM79/month. New subscribers can get a complimentary 5G smartphone through Zerolution when signing up for Maxis Postpaid 89 and above. Current promotions include RM10 off per month for 6 months and a complimentary sooka Premium subscription. All latest offers are available at maxis.com.my/en/mobile-plans.

  • All Maxis Postpaid plans come with unlimited 5G and 4G data, starting from RM79/month with the current promotion (Postpaid 89).

    Here's a quick comparison:

    Plan Promotional Price Key Benefit
    Postpaid 89 RM79/mth Best-value entry plan for a single user
    Postpaid 109 RM99/mth Supports 2 Supplementary Lines
    Postpaid 139 RM129/mth 3 Supplementary Lines + free sooka Premium
    Postpaid 169 RM159/mth 4 Supplementary Lines + free sooka Premium
    Postpaid 199 RM189/mth 5 Supplementary Lines + free sooka Premium

  • The Maxis Postpaid 89 plan is currently available at RM79/month for the first 6 months (normal price RM89/month), making it one of the most affordable unlimited 5G postpaid plans in Malaysia. It is recommended for single users who need reliable connectivity for everyday browsing, social media, and streaming—all within a RM100 budget. Available online and at Maxis stores nationwide, including Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley. 

  • It depends on your usage. Prepaid plans suit light users who want flexibility and no monthly commitment. However, if you use mobile data regularly, a postpaid plan typically offers better value—you get more data, often at unlimited levels, for a predictable monthly cost with no top-up hassle. For light to heavy users, the consistency and overall value of a postpaid plan generally outweigh prepaid options. 

  • Maxis offers Zerolution, a device instalment programme with zero upfront payment and zero interest, available across all Maxis Postpaid plans starting from RM79/month.

    Subscribers on Postpaid 139 and above also get a Yearly Upgrade option, allowing them to switch to the latest iPhone once 12 months or less remaining on their plan.
